title: Annual Four-Item Review and Follow-Up Planning
prompt: Some people believe that organisations should carry out a formal review of their four main annual commitments at the end of each year and then publish a clear plan for the following year. Others argue that such reviews are largely a waste of time, because priorities change too quickly for any plan to remain useful. To what extent do you agree or disagree with the view that annual four-item reviews and follow-up plans are worthwhile? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确题目要求你回应的立场：年度四项验收与后续安排是否值得开展。写作时需给出清晰立场，并用理由与例子支持；可讨论效率、问责、灵活性等角度，但不要写成单纯描述流程的说明文。建议先规划段落功能，再动笔，确保达到至少250词。
